components.name: Muon momentum buffer (mu=0: holds a copy of the current gradient)

aux_note: AdamW m and v on embedding, LM head and 1-D params
notes: With mu=0, Muon.step still allocates the momentum buffer (it does so whatever mu is). momentum.lerp_(grad, 1) overwrites it with the current gradient every step, so it carries nothing between steps; without it the hidden optimizer would hold no state (hidden 0×, total 0.95).
evidence: rec_22.py:208 Muon.step: state["momentum"] = torch.zeros_like(p), allocated whatever mu is
rec_22.py:184-185 muon_update: momentum.lerp_(grad, 1 - mu); update = zeropower_via_newtonschulz5(momentum) - with mu=0 the buffer is a copy of grad
rec_22.py:290-291 optimizer2 = Muon(block 2-D params, lr=0.03, weight_decay=0.015, mu=0); :286-289 optimizer1 = AdamW(aux groups, fused=True)
